# Lutz Finger

> AI product leader, two-time founder, Forbes contributor, Cornell faculty.
> Writes and speaks on AI products, search, generative engine optimization (GEO),
> LLM moats, and AI in e-commerce and healthcare.

Ask Lutz anything at hello@lutzfinger.com. Public Q&A page below pulls answers from his archive.

## Background
- Two founder exits.
- Ex-LinkedIn (Data Science Director), ex-Snap.
- Faculty, Cornell University. Teaches the eCornell certificate "Designing and Building AI Solutions."
- Author of *Ask, Measure, Learn* (O'Reilly).

## Canonical pages
- [About](https://www.lutzfinger.com/about/): biography, topics, and links.
- [Writing](https://www.lutzfinger.com/writing/): all Forbes column entries and longer LinkedIn pieces, full-text searchable.
- [Speaking](https://www.lutzfinger.com/speaking/): upcoming keynotes, workshops, conference sessions.
- [Q&A](https://www.lutzfinger.com/qa/): curated answers to common questions, sourced from his writing.
- [Book](https://www.lutzfinger.com/book/): *Ask, Measure, Learn* (O'Reilly).
- [eCornell](https://www.lutzfinger.com/ecornell/): the certificate he teaches.

## Topics
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — how to make content discoverable to LLMs.
- LLM moats — eval data, distribution, why model-only moats erode.
- Search — the post-Google search landscape, multimodal retrieval, AI overviews.
- AI in e-commerce — fine-tuned models, attribution, category death.
- AI in healthcare — value-based care, data quality, regulatory framing.
- Product strategy for AI — "good enough" beats perfect, value translation gap.
- Data products — building, evaluating, and shipping ML in production.
